    AI Overview
    Watch the 2026 Masters Tournament (April 6–12) through extensive free streaming on Masters.com and the Masters App, or via TV coverage on ESPN (early rounds) and CBS (weekend). Key coverage includes Amen Corner, featured groups, and holes 15 & 16, with additional coverage on Paramount+, Prime Video, and cable alternatives like Fubo. 
    2026 Masters Viewing Options: 
    • Free Streaming: Masters.com and the Official Masters App offer comprehensive, free live coverage of all four rounds, including featured groups and featured holes (4, 5, 6, 15, 16).
    • Television Coverage:
      • Thursday/Friday (Rounds 1-2): ESPN (3–7:30 p.m. ET).
      • Saturday (Round 3): CBS (3–7 p.m. ET).
      • Sunday (Final Round): CBS (2–7 p.m. ET).
    • Streaming Services:
      • Paramount+: Live simulcasts of CBS coverage and exclusive content.
      • Prime Video: Early round coverage (1–3 p.m. ET).
      • ESPN+: Featured groups and holes coverage.
    • Cable Alternatives: Fubo, YouTube TV, DirecTV Stream, and Hulu+Live TV carry ESPN and CBS. 
    Key 2026 Content Highlights 
    • "Masters on the Range": Daily coverage available on Masters.com and CBS Sports Network.
    • "Welcome to the Masters": Pre-tournament coverage on ESPN.
    • Featured Feeds: Dedicated coverage for Amen Corner (Holes 11, 12, 13) and Holes 15 & 16. 
    For full, up-to-the-minute coverage of tee times and leaderboard updates, visit the official Masters website.
